#!/bin/sh
### BEGIN INIT INFO
# Provides:          legacy-origin
# Required-Start:    $network $remote_fs

PIDFILE=/var/run/legacy-origin.pid
LOGFILE=/var/log/legacy-origin.log
case "$1" in
  start)
    start-stop-daemon --start --quiet --background --make-pidfile --pidfile "$PIDFILE" --exec "$DAEMON" -- "$APP" >>"$LOGFILE" 2>&1
    ;;
  stop)
    start-stop-daemon --stop --quiet --retry 5 --pidfile "$PIDFILE" --exec "$DAEMON" || true
    rm -f "$PIDFILE"
    ;;
  restart|force-reload)
    "$0" stop
    "$0" start
    ;;
  status)
    if start-stop-daemon --stop --test --quiet --pidfile "$PIDFILE" --exec "$DAEMON"; then exit 0; else exit 3; fi
    ;;
  *) echo "Usage: $0 {start|stop|restart|status}"; exit 1 ;;
esac
exit 0
ANTRIEB_EOF
